description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_GetRegisteredObject', which provides a method to retrieve a registered object from a Smarty template object, including error handling if the object is not registered or not an object.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetRegisteredObject
classes.description: Provides functionality to get registered objects within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: getRegisteredObject
methods.description: Returns a reference to a registered object by name from the Smarty template object, throwing exceptions if not found or invalid.
